component.name: Tube Clock
component.summary: Set up, back up and control IPS tube clocks

description.p: Tube Clock installs a replacement firmware on EleksTube style IPS "nixie" tube clocks (EleksTube, EleksTube Gen2, Si Hai, PunkCyber) and manages them afterwards.

ul.li: Backs up the original firmware before anything is changed
Configures WiFi (DHCP or static IP), time zone with automatic summer time and a daily internet time sync
Converts your own pictures into image sets, with a different picture per tube if you like
Finds clocks on the local network, syncs them with the computer's time, changes settings and uploads image sets

description.p: Warning: flashing firmware can damage the clock. Use at your own risk. The firmware is based on EleksTubeHAX by Mark Smith, Aljaz Ogrin, Martinius79 and contributors.
First release: new firmware 2.0.0 for the EleksTube family and the desktop app.
